subject: Social Media
title: Spotify's Discover Weekly
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Spotify's Discover Weekly.

hook.text: Every Monday, thirty songs appear. They feel handpicked. Over 40 million people listen weekly.

buildup.text: Spotify analyzes your history, skips, saves, and playlist adds to build a taste profile.

discovery.text: It also reads music blogs using language models. Cultural context shapes the recommendations.

twist.text: A folk singer in Iceland gained millions of plays overnight. The algorithm made her famous.

climax.text: The paradox: it shows you the unknown using only what you already know. Novelty from familiarity.

quiz.question: What makes Spotify's Discover Weekly feel personalized?
options: Analysis of listening patterns and cultural context
